Exercise: Cable Rear Delt Fly

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_shoulder_extension

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- enhance_rear_deltoid_development
- improve_shoulder_strength_and_stability

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Adjust the pulleys to the appropriate height and adjust the weight. The pulleys should be above your head.
- Grab the left pulley with your right hand and the right pulley with your left hand, crossing them in front of you. This will be your starting position.
- Initiate the movement by moving your arms back and outward, keeping your arms straight as you execute the movement.
- Pause at the end of the motion before returning the handles to the start position.
